links.outcome: Accuracy, efficiency, and misinformation risk when LLM answers are grounded in a curated document corpus
links.effect: Reported improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and computational cost on benchmark datasets; the curated document approach enhanced reliability and reduced misinformation risk. No numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: Comparative evaluations on benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and computational cost, with the curated document approach enhancing reliability and reducing misinformation risk.

unlisted_practices: Combining LLM summarization with cosine similarity metrics to keep synthesized insights domain-specific

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a system (Quanta) combining LLMs with retrieval metrics on curated dermatology literature datasets; it focuses on system performance/accuracy without evaluating a specific health care organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
